name: Boundless Skies
description: The scale of life goes beyond the world.
effect: Devotees of the Cosmic Beings may call upon 'Boundless Skies' once per quest as a bonus action during their combat turn, allowing them to roll 4d6 of Typeless damage against all foes. This is not affected by defenses, and the user must expend a Will point. At Acolyte, this Boon deals 1 flat damage ontop of any rolled successes. At Luminary, gain an extra charge of this Boon. At Paragon, increase the flat damage this boon provides by 1 and the damage dice by 1. At High Priest(ess), gain an additional charge of the boon and one more damage die.
